permissions.scripting: Used to inject SellerPilot functionality into Etsy pages where the extension runs. Injection is limited to the extension's declared Etsy host scope and user-initiated extension features.
permissions.activeTab: Used for actions that operate on the Etsy tab the seller is currently using, so SellerPilot can inspect or refresh the active page context when requested.
permissions.tabs: Used to identify and refresh open Etsy tabs after extension updates and to keep tab-specific conversation/page context isolated correctly across multiple Etsy tabs.
permissions.storage: Used to store extension settings, scoped Etsy conversation state, seller-defined memory, quick replies, cached listing/context metadata, diagnostics, and related local extension state.
permissions.unlimitedStorage: Used because long Etsy conversation histories, scoped context caches, listing metadata, and image-analysis metadata can exceed the normal extension storage quota for active sellers. This permission only increases local extension storage capacity and does not itself grant network access or transmit data.
permissions.downloads: Used only when the seller explicitly asks SellerPilot to save generated/exported content or files through the browser download mechanism.
permissions.alarms: Used for lightweight scheduled maintenance of extension state, such as cache/background housekeeping, without requiring the Etsy page to remain active.
permissions.offscreen: Used by Chromium builds for background/offscreen processing that cannot run reliably in the service worker alone. It is not used to display hidden advertising or unrelated content.

host_permissions.https://www.etsy.com/*: Required because SellerPilot is an Etsy seller assistant and must read the current Etsy page/conversation context and inject its UI on Etsy pages.
host_permissions.https://generativelanguage.googleapis.co: Required to send seller-initiated AI requests to configured Google Gemini models and receive their responses.
host_permissions.https://openrouter.ai/*: Required only when the seller selects/configures an OpenRouter-backed AI provider for an AI request.
host_permissions.https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bl0ck1: Used to retrieve the extension's remote compatibility configuration from the canonical public SellerPilot repository so Etsy selector/layout compatibility can be adjusted safely without unrelated remote code execution.

optional_host_permissions.https://*/*: Optional permission requested only for user-configured custom OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoints; it is not required for the default Etsy/Gemini workflow.
optional_host_permissions.http://localhost/*: Optional permission for seller-configured local development or self-hosted AI endpoints running on localhost.
optional_host_permissions.http://127.0.0.1/*: Optional permission for seller-configured local development or self-hosted AI endpoints addressed through 127.0.0.1.
